chapter_seo_title: Chapter 343: Shocked – Han Li Uncovers the Seven Sects’ Hidden Betrayal
chapter_meta_description: Han Li interrogates “Qu Hun” and learns that Spirit Beast Mountain was secretly a Demonic Path branch all along—and the entire war might be a trap.
og_title: Han Li’s Interrogation Shatters Everything You Knew About the Seven Sects
og_description: A single conversation rewrites the whole war arc: Spirit Beast Mountain was never truly orthodox, and Moon-Masking Sect has its own dark ties. This chapter is all about words as weapons.
twitter_title: Han Li just broke an enemy’s soul—not with force, but with logic. The secrets revealed? Game-changing. #RMJI
twitter_description: After a tense verbal duel, the captive drops the truth: the Demonic Path has been infiltrating the Seven Sects for centuries. This chapter is an absolute must-read.

lore_anchors.definition: A demonic sect from Tiandu Country specializing in spirit beasts and puppetry, revealed to have been secretly connected to Spirit Beast Mountain for centuries.
One of Yue’s Seven Great Sects, now exposed as a long-term infiltration branch of the Yu Ling Sect.
The most powerful of Yue’s Seven Great Sects, originally founded by the Harmony Sect but truly independent for centuries.
A demonic sect known for dual cultivation arts; ancestor sect of the Moon-Masking Sect.
A forbidden technique that extracts and tortures a soul; practitioners risk karmic backlash when using soul artifacts.
A self-binding vow sworn on a soul-linked magical tool; breaking the oath can cause the artifact to devour the user.
